title: VibeCheck – AI Code Standards Review Assistant
description: An AI-powered code review assistant that analyzes Python (PEP 8) and JavaScript (ESLint) compliance, providing automated feedback, violation detection, and improvement suggestions. Features an LLM agent pipeline using LangChain and Amazon Bedrock with documentation-aware prompts, conversational memory, and tool-based code analysis. Implements a CLI-based developer workflow tool that dynamically loads coding standards, processes code snippets, and generates structured AI review reports.
techStack: Python | LangChain | Amazon Bedrock | LLM Agents | CLI Tools

title: Arduino Day Philippines 2026 – Interactive 3D Activity Map
description: A production-grade interactive 3D venue navigation system developed for Arduino Day Philippines 2026, featuring comprehensive floor-by-floor exploration capabilities across a 12-story venue with 29 distinct locations and 40+ scheduled activities. Integrates real-time venue information, dynamic program schedules, and livestream access within an immersive 3D interface. Optimized using React memoization, event throttling, and Three.js rendering techniques, achieving consistent 60 FPS interaction, 44% faster load times, and 38% reduced memory usage.
techStack: Next.js | TypeScript | Three.js | Tailwind CSS | Framer Motion | REST API

title: Stampify – Digital ID Verification and Event Passport System
description: An enterprise-grade full-stack membership and event attendance management system featuring secure digital ID verification and QR code scanning capabilities. Implements comprehensive database logging mechanisms for user activity tracking, ensuring scalability, security, and long-term maintainability. Architected with a decoupled Next.js frontend and Spring Boot backend, deployed on AWS EC2 infrastructure with PostgreSQL database management through NeonDB and AWS S3 for scalable media storage.
techStack: Next.js | Java | Spring Boot | PostgreSQL | AWS S3 | AWS EC2 | Docker | REST API

title: Chem-Z: Chemistry Learning Management System

Features system-wide activity logging and modular academic components deployed across multi-cloud infrastructure utilizing DigitalOcean Droplets and AWS S3 for high availability and scalability.
techStack: Next.js | Java | Spring Boot | PostgreSQL | DigitalOcean | AWS S3 | REST API

title: eTapon: IoT-Enabled Smart Waste Management System
description: An intelligent waste management solution leveraging IoT sensors and real-time monitoring technology to detect bin capacity levels, transmit status updates, and promote responsible waste disposal practices through data-driven insights and analytics. Implements Raspberry Pi-based sensor integration with Python backend for efficient waste monitoring operations.

title: Guardian Vision – IoT Monitoring System for PWDs
description: A specialized IoT-based monitoring and emergency response system designed for persons with disabilities (PWDs), enabling hands-free emergency assistance through voice-activated alert mechanisms. Provides real-time notifications to designated caregivers, enhancing safety protocols and emergency responsiveness in residential and care facility environments. Integrates OpenAI Whisper for voice recognition and IoT sensors for comprehensive monitoring.
techStack: Next.js | Java | Spring | Spring Boot | PostgreSQL | OpenAI - Whisper | AWS | IoT | Raspberry Pi | Python
